title: Verify: StoryPanel dialog readability unit tests
summary: Assert StoryPanel root classes and choice/speaker classes.
description: Write tests/storyPanelReadable.test.tsx per R4 acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Root has story-content, no h-full or text-sm
Choices are w-full and speaker has font-pixel

steps.action: Render StoryPanel with a node {id:'n',speaker:'boy',text:'Hi',choices:[{text:'A'},{text:'B'}]}; expect container.firstChild toHaveClass('story-content') and not toHaveClass('h-full','text-sm'); getByRole('heading',{name:'boy'}) toHaveClass('font-pixel'); both buttons A and B toHaveClass('w-full').
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/storyPanelReadable.test.tsx tests/storyPanelDialogue.test.tsx
